property_summary: For any caller and any hash, the reference contract C never allows a caller to overwrite an existing locked guess (lockInGuess reverts if caller already has a pending guess), while the mutant removes that check and therefore for some inputs allows overwriting an existing guess (i.e. lockInGuess succeeds twice for same caller), violating the uniqueness rule.
change_summary: Changed the require that prevents multiple guesses by the same sender so it no longer blocks (removed the check), allowing overwriting an existing guess and block slot.
